tweet.text:
In the ChatGPT sidebar, Space is the new home for pages, slides, images, files, and uploads.

Build a page with ChatGPT: write, research, create images, and bring numbers to life with interactive charts. 

Turn an idea into a slide with images and graphics, then invite others to collab. If you have a dot, they can join in, too.

Set pages and slides to update automatically from your connected tools, so your to-do list stays fresh, your project tracker keeps up, and your trip itinerary has the latest plan.
